incidents.name: Service Disruption Notice due to AWS Outage – October 19-20, 2025

incident_updates.body: We experienced service disruptions between 11:48 PM PDT on October 19 and 2:20 PM PDT on October 20 due to a significant AWS outage in the Northern Virginia (US-EAST-1) region. Our services have now fully recovered following AWS's resolution of the underlying infrastructure issues. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. For complete details about the AWS incident, please refer to AWS's official post-incident report https://aws.amazon.com/message/101925/
This incident has been resolved.

To-dos
Manage Changes
Scheduled Emails
